```{r family-count-plot}
#| cache: true
#| fig-cap: "The 20 taxonomic families with the largest observation counts in the dataset."
# Number of level1_categories
level1_count <- data %>% count(level1_family, sort=TRUE)

# selection of the 20 most represented families

top20 <- level1_count %>%
  slice_head(n = 20)

ggplot(
  top20,
  aes(
    x = reorder(level1_family, n),
    y = n,
    fill = plant_category
  )
) +
  geom_col() +
  plot_labs(
    x = "Taxonomic family",
    y = "Observations (×100,000)",
    title = "Top 20 Plant Families by Observations",
    fill = "Plant category"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::label_number(scale = 1 / 100000, accuracy = 0.1)
  ) +
  theme_gtree() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

```
